metadata.description: The dev team that works while you’re away. It asks before it builds, and writes down who decided what: open decisions go to you one at a time and are recorded, and a separate session reviews the result and posts its verdict on the PR. Generic tooling only; each consumer repo supplies one config file and optional knowledge files.

plugins.name: dev-pipeline
plugins.description: Autonomous intaken-ticket → reviewed-PR pipeline: a scheduler over fresh build and review sessions, scheduler-run checks, a head-bound verdict comment, tracker adapters github|jira.

plugins.name: review-toolkit
plugins.description: Multi-agent parallel code review: review-lead orchestration with its Workflow-based fan-out, reviewer-baseline protocol, and the generic reviewer panel.

plugins.name: intake-toolkit
plugins.description: Elicitation surface: intake front door, intake-interviewer, intake-orchestrator, plan-interview with Decision Ledger, grill-me, decomposition-reviewer, implementability-probe.

plugins.name: design-toolkit
plugins.description: Design-fidelity toolkit: design-faithful translation/review skills and agents, with a config-selected design provider (figma or claude-design).

plugins.name: audit-toolkit
plugins.description: Session tool-call audit ledger: audit hooks, /audit and /audit-history query skills, self-tests.

plugins.name: second-shift
plugins.description: Onboarding + health for this marketplace: provenance-first /second-shift:onboard (writes consumer config, settings pin, lockfile), /second-shift:doctor (install-state verification), /second-shift:local-dev-refresh (machine-level plugin refresh). Install at user scope; it bootstraps everything else.
